blocks.raw: # Credit management
blocks.text: Credit management

blocks.raw: ### Manage Org SMS/Email Credits Introduction
blocks.text: Manage Org SMS/Email Credits Introduction

blocks.raw: Orgs are charged for communications (SMS, email, and X-Engage) sent to customers through Capillary products such as Loyalty+ or Engage+.  Capillary lets the org admins, finance teams, and Capillary Business teams manage org credits through Credits Management console. A user can add credits, remove credits, and monitor credit balance.
blocks.text: Orgs are charged for communications (SMS, email, and X-Engage) sent to customers through Capillary products such as Loyalty+ or Engage+.  Capillary lets the org admins, finance teams, and Capillary Business teams manage org credits through Credits Management console. A user can add credits, remove credits, and monitor credit balance.

blocks.raw: The following are the important points you need to know about credits.
blocks.text: The following are the important points you need to know about credits.

blocks.raw:
* 1 Credit = 1 unit of currency of the org - It could be INR, USD, SGD, AED, and so on.

* Estimated Credits in Message Summary is calculated using the default values set for the org and the entire audience list.

* The actual credits redemption and ledger update happen when the message is executed (based on customer availability and customer’s country code in case of SMS).

* Transaction SMS and Emails (Loyalty and OTP) also consume credits based on the rate card but it will not block sending messages even if there is an insufficient credit balance.  In that case, the credit balance will become negative.

blocks.raw: ### Manage Rate Cards - Setting cost of each credit for SMS, Email, and X-Engage
blocks.text: Manage Rate Cards - Setting cost of each credit for SMS, Email, and X-Engage

blocks.raw: You can set credit value for SMS, email, and X-Engage separately. For Orgs with customers in different countries, you can set rate-card country-wise. The changes made in the rate card will reflect from the next day.
blocks.text: You can set credit value for SMS, email, and X-Engage separately. For Orgs with customers in different countries, you can set rate-card country-wise. The changes made in the rate card will reflect from the next day.

blocks.raw: To add or update the rate card, follow these steps.
blocks.text: To add or update the rate card, follow these steps.

1. Sign in to InTouch with Capillary admin credentials, and on the Capillary Technologies org, navigate to Profile > Organization Settings > Credits Management > CreditsManagement.
2. Choose the org for which you want to update rate card.
3. On the Credit Management home page, click View rate card.

blocks.raw: ### Add Credits
blocks.text: Add Credits

blocks.raw: You can add credits to an org account and can set expiry for those credits.
blocks.text: You can add credits to an org account and can set expiry for those credits.

blocks.raw: To add credits, follow these steps.
blocks.text: To add credits, follow these steps.

blocks.raw: 1. On Credits Management, click **Add Credits**.
blocks.text: On Credits Management, click Add Credits.

blocks.raw: <Image align="center" className="border" border={true} src="https://files.readme.io/642db6d-Uyvkcj1p9ssy-GnpRGchhf7vuSnlbzdrTA.png" />

blocks.raw:
2. In **How many credits do you want to add**, enter the credits that you want to add.
3. In **When do these credits expire**, set the expiry for the credits - 1 month, 2 months, 3 months, 6 months, and 1 year. 4. If you do not want to expire credits, select Never.
4. In **Purchase order number**, enter the purchase order number of the credits (if available).
5. In **Comments**, enter any note for the current credits.
6. Click **Done** to save.
